description_en: Prepares the SCIM receiving configuration and returns the provisioning URL and credential summary. Issues a token if no available credentials exist and returns the plaintext only in this response, without automatically enabling AgentCore user synchronization
description_zh: 准备 SCIM 接收配置，返回预配 URL 和凭据摘要；没有可用凭据时签发 Token，仅本次返回明文，不自动开启 AC 用户同步
name: PrepareIdentityProviderSCIM

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the destination workspace. The region of the request must be the same as the region of the destination workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

code.description_en: The business result code. If the call fails, handle the error based on the HTTP status code and the message
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

data.description_en: The operation result. For the result structure, see the response fields of this operation. The response of an asynchronous write operation indicates that the request is accepted, but does not guarantee that the background task is completed
data.description_zh: 结果结构见本接口返回字段；异步写接口的返回表示受理，不保证后台任务已完成

configuration.description_en: The actual SAML configuration is read on demand only by calling GetIdentityProvider. SCIM query and preparation operations return the actual receiving status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

baseUrl.description_en: The URL configured for the external provisioning system. The presence of a URL does not indicate that the external configuration is completed or AgentCore synchronization is enabled
baseUrl.description_zh: 配置给外部预配系统的 URL；有地址不代表已完成外部配置或开启 AC 同步
baseUrl.title_en: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址
baseUrl.title_zh: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址

status.description_en: The receiving status of AgentIdentity. A value of Enabled indicates that SCIM receiving is enabled. A value of Disabled indicates that SCIM receiving is disabled. This status is not equivalent to the expected value of syncEnabled in AgentCore
status.description_zh: Enabled 表示已开启 SCIM 接收，Disabled 表示关闭；不等同 AC 的 syncEnabled 期望值

credential.description_en: The current credential summary, including credentialId, status, createTime, and expireTime. The token is not included because it cannot be repeatedly obtained

createTime.description_en: The creation time returned by AgentIdentity

credentialId.description_en: The credential ID. This parameter is required when you delete a credential. Use the ID returned in the credential list, not the plaintext of the token
credentialId.description_zh: 删除时必填非空，使用凭据列表返回的 ID，不是 Token 明文

expireTime.description_en: The expiration time returned by AgentIdentity. Only credentials with the status of Enabled that have not expired are considered available
expireTime.description_zh: AgentIdentity 返回的到期时间；仅 Enabled 且尚未过期的凭据视为可用

status.description_en: The credential status of AgentIdentity. Only credentials with the status of Enabled that have not expired are considered available. This field is not the operationStatus of the SCIM task
status.description_zh: 仅 Enabled 且尚未过期的凭据视为可用；此字段不是 SCIM 任务 operationStatus

token.description_en: The plaintext of the newly issued SCIM token. The plaintext is returned only in the current response. If an existing valid credential is reused, an empty string ("") is returned. In this case, use the saved token
token.description_zh: 本次新签发的 SCIM Token 明文，仅在签发当次返回。复用已有有效凭据时返回空字符串（""），此时使用已保存的 Token
token.title_en: 仅新建凭据当次返回，已存在凭据时为空
token.title_zh: 仅新建凭据当次返回，已存在凭据时为空

httpStatusCode.description_en: The processing status of the current request. This status does not indicate the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: The request acceptance or error message. For asynchronous tasks, you must check the task result by calling the corresponding query operation
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to associate the current call with troubleshooting. Keep the ID if the call fails
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the current request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. For asynchronous write operations, you must continue to query the task result
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
